# OSIEN Probe

> Offline static source analysis, 11-language tree-sitter AST bug finder, same-file taint tracker, secret scanner, and zero-dependency stdio MCP server by OSIEN.

## Links
- [OSIEN Probe Homepage](https://osienprobe.vercel.app/): Interactive 3D showcase, live scan preview, and quickstart.
- [OSIEN Probe Documentation](https://osienprobe.vercel.app/#docs): Visual architecture diagrams for humans and MCP/CLI specs for AI agents.
- [OSIEN Probe GitHub Repository](https://github.com/kabirprokk/OSIEN-Probe): Source code, desktop app, CLI, and MCP server (MIT license).
- [OSIEN Parent Organization](https://osien.is-a.dev/): The broader OSIEN software and developer tooling ecosystem.

## Core Capabilities
- Zero code execution: Static analysis only; no project code is executed during a scan.
- 11-language AST: Babel for JS/TS plus 11 `@ast-grep` tree-sitter grammars (Python, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, C/C++, C#, Ruby, PHP, Swift, Bash).
- Same-file taint tracking: Tracks input-to-sink flows and recognizes sanitizers (`DOMPurify.sanitize`, `encodeURIComponent`, `path.basename`).
- Entropy secret scanning: Flags AWS, GitHub PAT, Stripe, OpenAI, Anthropic, Slack, GCP, and private keys.
- Local Ollama AI triage: Optional snippet-only verification using local `qwen3.5:0.8b` with fast-fail circuit breaker.
- Reports & CI gating: SARIF 2.1.0, Markdown, JSON, and `--fail-on <severity>`.

## CLI & MCP Usage
- Interactive TUI: `probe`
- Static scan: `probe scan <path> --kind "Website" --sarif --fail-on high`
- MCP stdio server: `node bin/osien-probe-mcp.cjs` (tools: `scan_project`, `inspect_finding_context`, `verify_finding_with_ai`, `list_rules`)
